question: According to the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, no person under the age of ________ years shall be granted a learner's, license to drive a motor cycle without gear except with the consent in writing of the person having the care of the person desiring the learner's license.
solution:
The correct answer is __**eighteen.**__

 
• According to the **Motor Vehicles Act, 1988,** no person under the age of **18 years** shall be granted a learner's, license to drive a motorcycle without gear except with the consent in writing of the person having the care of the person desiring the learner's license.
